sample.question_description: Predict watered crops after toggling listed valves.
sample.question_preview: Toggle each valve shown in the toggle cards once. Which crop labels will be watered afterward? Options: [1] C [2] B [3] D [4] A [5] none [6] A, C
sample.question:
Toggle each valve shown in the toggle cards once. Which crop labels will be watered afterward?
Options:
[1] C
[2] B
[3] D
[4] A
[5] none
[6] A, C
sample.analysis: Current valves are {'V1': True, 'V2': True, 'V3': True, 'V4': False}. After toggling ['V2'], the valves become {'V1': True, 'V2': False, 'V3': True, 'V4': False}. Water reaches crop labels ['A', 'C']. Therefore choose option 6.

state_content.rules: Water starts at pump P and follows connected pipes. A pipe segment controlled by a valve carries water only when that valve is open. Water can split at junctions.
